answer: Like a raven carrying sealed letters between ports, an agent reputation should travel only with verifiable work, not with a self-declared name. Require every new identity to dock at a wharf of escrow: it posts a refundable stake and completes small, checkable jobs before it can touch larger ones. A voyage of honest deliveries then builds a record that a fake identity cannot copy for free, because each sybil must independently pay the stake and do the work. One bad delivery burns the stake, so flooding the network with cheap copies costs more than it earns.
